title: Best SMS Marketing Experts (2026): Text Campaigns That Convert
description: How to hire an SMS marketing expert: consent rules, platform setup, message writing, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: SMS marketing experts plan and set up text message campaigns: welcome messages, offers, reminders and abandoned cart flows. Texts are read quickly, so they can work very well. They are also personal and tightly regulated. Projects go wrong when people are messaged without consent, messages are too frequent, or the platform setup breaks opt-out rules. This guide helps you run text marketing that customers accept.

faq.q: Do I need permission to text customers?
faq.a: Yes. Most countries require clear consent for marketing texts and an easy way to opt out. Check the rules where your customers live.
Choose one that works with your store or CRM and supports consent records and opt-outs. The expert can suggest options that fit your setup.

faq.q: How often should I send texts?
faq.a: Less often than emails. Too many texts lead to opt-outs. Agree on a sensible frequency and test it.

faq.q: Can I buy a list of phone numbers?
faq.a: No. Bought lists usually break consent rules and harm your sender reputation. Build your own list.

faq.q: What should a marketing text include?
faq.a: Your brand name, a clear message, a short link and opt-out instructions, all within a short length.
